messages:
elaine.s: Hey team — heads up: BridgeTech POC is ready to sign but procurement wants the signer reassigned and legal flagged multiple redlines (MSA + DPA + HSM addendum). Need routing advice and owners. OrderForm ID OF-2026-0423.
marco.legal: send the redlines pls. quick skim: HSM addendum + EU DPA usually the tricky bits.
elaine.s: uploaded here: https://drive.redwood/bridgetech/OF-2026-0423-redlines (PDF). also they added a clause to require KMS attestation.
josh.se: pricing question — are they going Dedicated or Hosted for the POC? that affects billing terms we put on the OF.
elaine.s: Dedicated 4xA100 trial for 30 days. they asked about burst capacity and a usage cap.
ton y.finance: (tony.finance): billing needs: PO number and whether invoice should go to payables@bridgetech.com or procurement@bridgetech.com. Net30 default unless they request otherwise.
elaine.s: procurement asked for net45 in the call, but finance wants net30. can procurement sign PO first and then we invoice on Net30?
marco.legal: Net45 is negotiable but needs exec approval if >60k. Regarding HSM/KMS attestation, suggested redline: replace broad attestation ask with: "Customer KMS/HSM attestation to SOC2 Type II or equivalent; specific HSM vendor naming to be captured in Appendix A." I'll paste quick redline.
marco.legal: ```Suggested MSA change: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) permitted; Redwood will support customer attestation to SOC2 Type II or equivalent. Detailed HSM vendor requirements to be agreed in Appendix A."```
meera.security: Security questionnaire flagged: S3 cross-account copy, retention policy, and syslog forwarding. Need confirmation on data residency and whether logs include customer PII. I'll create SQ ticket #SQ-788 and request clarifications from BridgeTech.
josh.se: For the signer reassignment: procurement will sign the PO, but BridgeTech legal needs to countersign the MSA. Our usual flow: 1) Receive PO from procurement -> 2) Sales uploads PO to OF -> 3) Procurement signs OF -> 4) Redwood countersigns MSA (legal). Is that still what procurement expects?
elaine.s: They specifically asked to replace the primary signer (eliza@bridgetech.com) with procurement@bridgetech.com. Also asked that legal countersign after we accept.
marco.legal: That's fine. We should set the DocuSign envelope to require sequential signing: procurement -> Redwood legal. Otherwise countersign gets messy.
docusign-bot: Envelope created: env_7801 for OF-2026-0423. Signing order set to sequential. Link: https://docusign/redwood/env_7801
ton y.finance: Need the invoice remit and PO number before we finalize. elaine.s can you confirm PO number once procurement sends?
elaine.s: will confirm. also need to know if HSM attestation requires an SLA change or additional SOW (they mentioned "attestation tests").
marco.legal: If attestation requires additional deliverables, we should scope as an Appendix/SOW and not change core SLA. Propose Appendix B for HSM attestation scope.
meera.security: I'll ask BridgeTech to clarify retention windows and whether logs go to their external SIEM. If logs include PII we'll need a tighter DPA clause.
josh.se: Also note: if they spin up Dedicated in EU region we can meet residency. but Dedicated config must be in the OF as "region: eu-west-1".
elaine.s: quick OF snippet for the envelope: ```OrderForm: OF-2026-0423
Plan: Dedicated Standard (4xA100)
Region: eu-west-1
Start: 2026-04-15
Billing: Net30 (finance tentative)
PO: <pending>```
marco.legal: I'll attach the redline PDF to the envelope and set signer assignment: procurement@bridgetech.com (signs OF), then Redwood legal (marco.legal) countersigns MSA.
ton y.finance: If final ARR > $120k we need exec approval for Net45. keep me posted.
meera.security: SQ-788 created. ETA: EOD for list of clarifying Qs to BridgeTech.
elaine.s: assigning owners: @marco.legal = legal redline/countersign, @meera.security = SQ follow-up, @tony.finance = billing/PO terms, @josh.se = technical verification for Dedicated config. I'll update CRM & attach this thread. :thumbsup:
marco.legal: :thumbsup:
josh.se: ack, will validate Dedicated tuning and confirm any limits by noon.
meera.security: ack — I'll DM BridgeTech for the retention details.
ton y.finance: ack, will flag Net45 risk if PO arrives with that term.
elaine.s: thanks all — will wait for PO + answers to SQ before completing the envelope. updating thread when envelope is signed.
marco.legal: FYI, if BridgeTech insists on lighthouse HSM vendor naming, we'll need to loop in solutions engineering for compatibility checks.
elaine.s: noted. end.
